metric_contract.conditional_gate: perfect_run: average only find runs whose task accuracy is 1.0; a (builder, finder, task) cell contributes if at least one run is perfect
metric_contract.headline: total_bytes = novel_retrieval_bytes + novel_tool_call_bytes
metric_contract.normalization: within each (finder, task), divide each builder cell by the minimum builder cost in the same panel
metric_contract.preferred_recovery: soft_full_recovery = accuracy ** question_count / inspection bytes, normalized by the maximum builder value within each (finder, task), then geomean across cells

recovery_diagnostics.answer_accuracy: legacy answer-level accuracy divided by inspection bytes; retained as a diagnostic because it can over-reward low-cost partial recovery
recovery_diagnostics.perfect_run_rate: observed perfect-task run rate divided by inspection bytes; strict but high variance with six runs per cell

secondary_gates.all_runs: average every run, regardless of accuracy
secondary_gates.max_penalty: use perfect-run mean when available; otherwise assign the max all-run mean cost observed in the same (finder, task)

panels.description: Primary high-effort panel: high builders inspected by high finders
Primary low-effort panel: low builders inspected by low finders
Diagnostic only: all builders and all finders pooled across effort regimes
